Problem Statement:
\nHackerCon is conducting a hackathon for hackers to hack a self-driving automatic car that has been developed newly, to record the car's security breach index. The car is locked digitally with a matrix consisting of positive and negative integers. Only the owner of the car knows the matrix. The car's unlock code is unique. However, a group of hackers found a glitch in the car's software and reported that it can also be unlocked with the inverse of the matrix. This proved that the car did not have a unique unlock code. That group of hackers won the hackathon. Given a matrix, find out which was the matrix that the hackers used to unlock the car.\n\n
Input Description:
\nDimensions of the square matrix followed by the elements of a matrix\n\n
Output Description:
\nInverse of the matrix. If inverse does not exist, output “ Inverse does not exist”\n\n
Explanation:
\nThe inverse of the matrix is calculated using the necessary steps.\n\n
Sample Input:
\n2 2\n1 2\n3 4\n\n
Sample Output:
\n-2 1\n1.5 -0.5\n\n
